title: 6 key questions about US energy storage in 2026 answered
gist: Wood Mackenzie's Q3 2026 US Energy Storage Monitor shows record 18.9 GWh installed in Q2 2026 on longer durations even as GW fell, with utility-scale stagnating through 2027 and residential in a third straight quarterly decline after Section 25D credits ended. Data centre buildout is the main upside driver across all segments.

insights.claim: The US installed a record 18.9 GWh of energy storage in Q2 2026 even though installed power in GW fell, because average storage duration rose.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Track GWh rather than GW as the better gauge of storage deployment; duration is the growth lever.
insights.locator: 1. What was behind record overall energy storage installations

insights.claim: Longer-duration storage, driven by solar and wind penetration, falling battery costs, data centre growth and policy incentives, is moving storage from ancillary balancing to a structural grid role.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Favors long-duration storage developers and integrators over short-duration frequency-regulation exposure.
insights.quote: Longer duration storage is supporting a transition from ancillary balancing towards a more structural role.
insights.locator: 1. What was behind record overall energy storage installations

insights.claim: The Q2 2026 record was helped by a long-duration project in California built to meet state targets and by utility-contracted storage assets in Texas.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: California and Texas remain the key state markets to watch for storage procurement.
insights.locator: 1. What was behind record overall energy storage installations

insights.claim: US utility-scale storage deployments in MW terms have stagnated in 2026 on supply chain adjustments, and stagnation is expected to continue through 2027.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Expect flat near-term utility-scale volumes; avoid underwriting growth before 2028.
insights.locator: 2. Why are US utility-scale energy storage deployments down

insights.claim: Wood Mackenzie expects utility-scale storage growth to resume in 2028 as domestic cell manufacturing ramps up, aided by state incentives, large-load management needs and a rush of renewable installs before Production Tax Credits end in 2030.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Domestic cell makers and 2030 PTC deadline timing are the catalysts for the rebound.
insights.locator: 2. Why are US utility-scale energy storage deployments down

insights.claim: US residential storage fell for a third consecutive quarter in Q2 2026 after the elimination of Section 25D clean energy tax credits weakened demand.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Residential storage and solar installers face policy-driven demand erosion.
insights.quote: The elimination of Section 25D clean energy tax credits has weakened demand for residential energy storage

insights.claim: Battery-only installations in Texas are partly offsetting the nationwide residential slowdown, which is also driven by tax equity tightness, consumer hesitancy and a difficult third-party-ownership transition.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Texas is the relative bright spot in residential; financing structure is a key risk.

insights.claim: The top five US residential storage markets in Q2 2026 were California, Texas, Puerto Rico, Arizona and Illinois, and all five declined quarter-on-quarter.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Even leading markets are contracting, so the slowdown is broad.
insights.locator: 4. Which US states are driving residential energy storage demand growth?

insights.claim: Annual US storage installations are expected to grow significantly in MW terms over five years as low costs push storage into new regions and use cases, with the community-scale, commercial and industrial segment expanding beyond California.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: CCI storage is the segment to watch for geographic diversification.
insights.locator: 5. What will propel energy storage installation growth

insights.claim: Data centre buildout lifts the US storage outlook across all segments because utility-scale storage offers hyperscalers speed to power amid grid-connection bottlenecks.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: Storage is a speed-to-power workaround for AI data centre load; link storage names to hyperscaler capex.
insights.quote: Utility-scale storage in particular offers speed to power to hyperscalers, who increasingly face project delays due to grid-connection bottlenecks.
insights.locator: 6. How is data centre buildout impacting the US energy storage outlook?

insights.claim: CCI and residential storage will also benefit from data centre-driven load growth as the industry positions virtual power plants as a key enabler.
insights.speaker: Gaby Ackermann Logan
insights.so_what: VPP aggregators are a potential beneficiary of load growth.
